name: MAX interactor 1, dimerization protein
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MXI1 encodes max-interacting protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and protein dimerization activity. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
